reviews.title: Sad to see magicplan stop caring about sole traders
reviews.text:
I'm a property photographer, and I was about to sign up to magicplan to produce floor plans for estate agents. The Sketch plan, at £12.99 a month, was exactly what I needed. When I contacted support, they told me Sketch has been discontinued and that Report, at £39.99 a month, is now the only option for single users. You wouldn't know this from their website or App Store listing: the help centre still lists Sketch, and the App Store's in-app purchases still include it at £12.99 a month. Support says they're updating it, but right now it's unclear and misleading.

I produce about five floor plans a day. Every plan now effectively has a per-plan price: Report's quota of 10 works out at £4 a plan, and Pro (£140–£250 for 10) at £14–£25 a plan, compared with about 12p a plan under Sketch. Neither comes close to covering my volume, so for volume work it's simply not commercially viable.

Support offered no alternative. It's sad to see a company that used to serve independent professionals so well stop caring about sole traders and the kind of users Sketch served. If you need floor plans at volume, look elsewhere.

reviews.title: 2 free designs - scam
reviews.text: I forgot why I'd not used Magicplan for a while. I reset my password and found I had a few designs still saved. So I opened a couple of them in 'read-only' format, mindful that I only had 2 free edits available to me and each design that I opened lost me one free credit until I had none! What a nonesense.

reviews.title: Imports
reviews.text: Almost impressively to import a floor plan from another tool.  I have lots of single room plans and the ‘promised’ feature was I could add all these with snap to fit even after importing.  I am resorting to drawing over an imported photograph of a site plan from Land Registry.   After I have 3D scans of every room and exportable plans.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Just lots of glitching and error messages. Promised much, delivered little I’m afraid.

reviews.title: Sadly didn’t deliver
reviews.text: Such a great concept and in my trail project it worked fine.  But when on site abroad where us was critical it kept crashing on wifi and 5g so a total bust and caused allot of issue with project.    Support were little or no help.

reviews.title: Free projects are a con
reviews.text: You are unable to delete projects an any settings changes like changing for US Burgers/Guns measurements to metric do not apply to already created projects…that you can’t delete.

reviews.title: Having to start all over again
reviews.text: I’ve done my plan scaled it and brought all my rooms. I put the exact scale in checked it saved it and magicplan has made it about eight times a scale so now I’m having to delete everything that’s taken me over an hour to do and start all over again. Reason magicplan does not allow you to change the scale once it’s been created this is absolute garbage.

reviews.title: No idea how to work this over complicated
reviews.text: Not intuitive and doesn’t respond very well. If they want people to buy it, then make the trial more useable as so far  I cannot get any sense out of what is basically a toy that doesn’t work. I’ll never pay for this due to unable to get it to work out understand the interface

reviews.title: It’s good at first but …
reviews.text: I’m using this app for over a year as an interior deaigner, it was good at first but the subscription fee is too high compare with what I can have: limited object, the dimensions are not so correct sometime, the app has bug in which sometime when you copied the rooms, walls were disappearing and all the objects jumped to other places. It’s really annoying! With the fee, I would expect better quality and objects. Moving to a better app now! If you only use this app for personal uses, it’s ok but for business, it’s not!

reviews.title: Terrible Support
reviews.text: Having used the plan commercially for a number of months I can say with honesty that 80% of the time you’ll create good plans with self manageable edits. However for the other 20% of the time when support is required, when time is ticking and the plan is urgent you’ll become very anxious with the lack of phone support, the speed at which an enquiry is worked and the days it will take them to fix simple issues. It’s a shame to be writing this review for an app that could be amazing. I’m sure in time it will improve.

reviews.title: Can’t Scan Vaulted/Sloping Ceilings!! 😤
reviews.text: Would be 5 stars if it could incorporate vaulted and/or sloping ceilings BUT it doesn’t!! As a decorator who quotes on price per square foot of walls and ceilings this app doesn’t work !
